column3: Novotny.
Vera's place. The main again. Right, I'll come out. Half an hour. Sixty for the call-out.
Nothing's broken? Then I'm not driving out to look at a working box.
I said I'm on my way. Don't ring again.
Mm... Novotny.
It's gone nine. Double after nine: a hundred and twenty. I'll be an hour. Leave the barrier up.
Then why are you ringing me at this hour?
No. Not tonight. I drove past there an hour ago... and I didn't stop. Ring me in the morning.
Veterinary practice, Lesna. Surgery hours are eight till twelve. For large animals, ring after six.
District office, accommodation.
The guest register goes in GuestRack. We have told Mrs Kralova twice. Good day.
Water board. Blockages inside the camp are the operator's responsibility. Do not flush rags.
Hlubocany bus station. Line three-eighty to Cerne jezero: six fifteen, nine forty, thirteen oh five, sixteen thirty, and eighteen forty. The last bus back from the camp leaves at nineteen fifteen.
Jednota, Lesna.
Bread comes with the van. And tell Vera the crates are hers to bring back.
U Jezera!
What? I can't hear you, the jukebox is on! Come down if you want a drink!
Hlubocany District Power, faults. Our crews do not go out to the reservoir after dark. Call your electrician.
District Power, faults.
Your side of the meter is your electrician's job. Novotny, isn't it? His number's in the book.
Police, Hlubocany.
The camp. Right. Lock the office door, and stay inside. We will send someone in the morning.
Lost property is on Wednesdays. Is there anything else?
Emergency.
Is anyone hurt? The forest road is closed to us after dark. Bandage it, and ring in the morning.
The mobile subscriber is unavailable. Please call later.
This is Vera Kralova. If it is about the camp... the camp is fine.
This is Vera Kralova. If it is about the camp... count them again.
The number you have dialled does not exist.
At the third stroke, it will be
precisely.
